items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: Dave Capp had a big sign, with an Indian like this, praying to heaven.

ctx.x: Yeah, because I don’t know they’re into the old —

Dave Capp had a big sign, with an Indian like this, praying to heaven. And the sign says “play the melody.” In the Decca studios. So that was the money part of playing it. So I hung in with this for a long time, and went into conducting at NBC and studying arranging and composing, and formed my own company to write jingles for 25 years. I didn’t do much playing horn at that time except when we’d have a session and the guys would come in, I’d do that. And then I came down here to Sarasota to retire, and picked up…
You’d get a contract to do like a jingle for some company —
